## What's new

- **Game cards match SteamGridDB's landscape covers.** Cards in Continue Playing and All Games now use the covers' 460×215 proportions, so they're wider and the whole cover shows without cropping the logo.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
